what_it_is: A hardcover travel-and-fashion bookazine from Barcelona in which every issue is devoted to a single destination (recently Türkiye, Andalusia and Cambodia). Each volume of over 250 pages combines fashion editorials shot on location, essays on local culture and craft, a travel handbook section and features on hotels. It is aimed at design-minded travellers and fashion readers who want a collectable object rather than a guidebook.
